flashcard_questions.q: What is stewardship in Christian teaching about the earth?
flashcard_questions.a: Caring for creation on God’s behalf, using resources wisely.

flashcard_questions.q: What is khalifah in Islamic teaching about the earth?
flashcard_questions.a: The role of caretaker, accountable to Allah for the environment.

flashcard_questions.q: What does dominion mean in Genesis 1:28?
flashcard_questions.a: The God-given authority of humans over other living creatures.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Genesis verse tells humans to work the earth and take care of it?
What did Pope Francis call the earth in Laudato Si’?
What did the Prophet Muhammad teach about wasting water?
flashcard_questions.a: “Do not waste water even if you are at a running stream.”

flashcard_questions.q: Which year has the Church of England set for reaching net zero carbon?
Which Christian organisation runs conservation projects worldwide?
When does the Catholic Church accept animal experimentation?
flashcard_questions.a: When it stays within reasonable limits and helps save human lives.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do Quakers oppose animal experimentation?
flashcard_questions.a: Because it causes unnecessary suffering to God’s creatures.

flashcard_questions.q: Which proverb teaches that the righteous care for their animals?
What did the Prophet Muhammad say about wrongfully killing a sparrow?
flashcard_questions.a: The killer will have to answer for it on the Day of Judgement.

flashcard_questions.q: What makes meat halal for Muslims?
flashcard_questions.a: The animal is slaughtered humanely in the name of Allah.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Gospel verse do Christians use to show that all foods are clean?
What is Peter Singer’s argument about the moral status of animals?
flashcard_questions.a: Animals can suffer, so they deserve moral consideration.

notes: 15 cards: 4 term→definition (stewardship, khalifah, dominion, halal), 4 belief→source (Genesis 2:15, Proverbs 12:10, Mark 7:19, sparrow hadith), 3 denomination→position (Catholic view, Quaker view, Peter Singer), 2 organisation facts (A Rocha, Church of England 2030), 2 quotations (Laudato Si’, running stream).
